verdict.rationale: Parsec lists 'Virtual monitors' and 'Multi-monitor streaming (Up to 3)' as its own features, and it ships an Android client a tablet could use. That plausibly lets a connecting device show an additional virtual display rather than a mirror, but the evidence is bare feature labels with no description of extend-versus-mirror behavior. The Wacom tablet items describe pen input, not a display, so they are not credited. missing for 10: explicit documentation that a client tablet or spare device can act as an extended second screen alongside the host's own display, setup details for the virtual monitor feature, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of the workflow.
